text.p: Alternate Postal Delivery Inc said Friday that Dale Krieger has tendered his resignation as the company's chairman and as a member of its board of directors, effective January 1, 1997.
The company said its board has elected President and Chief Executive Officer Phillip Miller as its new chairman. Miller will retain both his CEO and president titles.
Krieger said in a statement that his decision was a result of increased commitments and opportunities resulting from the merger of his company, Carnegie-Hill.

In addition, Krieger said Alternate Postal has reached a point for transition in leadership with the attainment of important milestones in 1996, including the acquisitions of Preferred Customer Delivery Inc and National Home Delivery Inc.
